tiers.description: Released game dialogue, events, books, item descriptions, loading screens, official game data
tiers.default_use: primary evidence for what the released work depicts or states

tiers.description: Officially published external lore, manuals, promotional fiction and licensed/official publications
tiers.default_use: official external evidence with document-specific context

tiers.description: Design documents, drafts, concept material and internal-style notes reproduced with provenance
tiers.default_use: development-history evidence; not automatically shipped canon

tiers.description: Out-of-character interviews, Q&A and explanatory developer posts
In-character developer roleplay and fiction outside released works
Fan analysis, questions, summaries and community synthesis
tiers.default_use: discovery and interpretation only unless independently sourced

precedence_rule: No global tier mechanically wins a contradiction. Authority class, date, continuity, subject, directness and the question being answered determine relevance; preserve conflicting evidence.
adoption_rule: If an idea later appears in released primary material, create a new released-primary evidence record linked to the earlier developmental antecedent.
